assertions.source: Maya quadratic rep exact (N_v=sum(1-m_a)m_{a+v}, omega3=sum v^2 N_v-n^2-C(n,2), n<=10); occupations determinantal (BOO); poissonized Cov_theta(N_v,Sum h^2) all positive (|lambda|-comovement dominates) ⇒ depoissonization is the real obstruction. Structural bridge + obstruction, not a proof. No fit; no c_k.

description: DPP route deliverable 1 (qou-x631, qou-g0n2): the Maya-diagram quadratic representation that makes the Borodin–Okounkov–Olshanski determinantal tool applicable to the covariance kernel, plus the depoissonization obstruction that is its real difficulty. Encode λ by its Maya diagram m_a=1_{a∈{λ_i−i}}. EXACT (n≤10): N_v=Σ_a(1−m_a)m_{a+v} (hook=particle-hole distance, quadratic in m) and ω₃=Σ_v v²N_v−n²−C(n,2) (via Σh²=Σc²+n², quadratic in m). So Cov(N_v,ω₃) is a covariance of two quadratic statistics; under θ-poissonized Plancherel the occupations are a DETERMINANTAL point process (discrete-Bessel kernel, BOO math/9905032), giving a Wick/kernel reduction of Cov(N_v,N_w). OBSTRUCTION (honest finding): the kernel condition Σ_v ν_v=0 holds at FIXED n because Σ_v N_v=n is constant (|λ|-comovement projected out); at POISSONIZED level |λ| fluctuates and dominates, so Cov_θ(N_v,Σh²) comes out ALL POSITIVE (θ=4: +12.5,…,+0.08) — opposite sign. Hence the DPP kernel must be DEPOISSONIZED (conditioned on |λ|=n) before its sign reflects the fixed-n covariance; that conditioning, not the kernel algebra, is where the route's difficulty concentrates. Scopes the next attempt: the |λ|=n-conditioned discrete-Bessel kernel / steepest-descent depoissonization with |λ|-mean-field subtraction. Establishes the exact bridge + names the obstruction; does NOT prove the kernel. scope-(a); no fit; nothing wired; no c_k; L2 2/7.
